text:
anya: quick heads-up — mock for a new "metrics strip" on model cards ready for review. idea: show p95 latency, cost/token, and perf badge inline to help quick scans. compact by default, expand on hover/tap. attaching screenshot in figma. sam: nice. can you clarify 'compact'? is that icons-only with tooltip, or tiny numbers? browser perf matters if we render extra dom for each card. maria: from testing with 12 users, participants liked a single-line glance metric. icons-only caused too much guesswork. they expected a short numeric + unit (e.g., 82ms, $0.002/tk). dave: implementation note — we can compute cost/token client-side from model metadata. p95 needs precomputed histograms from backend; can't stream for every card. anya: thanks — plan is icons + 2 small numbers (latency + cost). on hover we expand to show last-1h and model size. mobile tap toggles expand. olivia: two UX asks: 1) ensure badges meet 3:1 contrast min for small text; 2) microcopy for the badge tooltip should avoid jargon. suggest "Estimated p95 latency (client request)" -> "Typical response time (p95)". sam: re contrast — we can use an outline variant on dark badge with text color #0f172a. i'll prototype both fill and outline. maria: throwaway note from sessions — participants wanted a visual cue when a model is pinned to a version. they missed current tiny pin affordance during compare flows. ya: (iya) — re: version pinning, i sketched a "lock" mode: click pin -> dropdown with options: latest, major-only, exact. choosing major-only pins major version but follows minor updates. would help safe-rollouts. dave: engineering: "major-only" is doable if we maintain semantic tags in model registry. exact pin requires storing model digest. both ok but we should show the pinned resolution in the card (e.g., v2.x or v2.3.1). olivia: microcopy suggestion for dropdown: "Use latest compatible (major)" -> shorter: "Stick to major version" maria: users liked the major-only idea — it gives stability without blocking patch improvements. sam: keyboard accessibility: we should support focus on card metrics via Tab, and Enter to expand. aria-expanded on the card and aria-labels for each metric. example: ```
…
``` olivia: yes — and we need to ensure screenreader reads the pinned state: "Pinned to v2.x" vs "Pinned to v2.3.1". anya: good call. i'll update the figma and copy. also propose adding a tiny "undo" toast after changing pin resolution "Pinned to v2.x · Undo". dave: backend: we'll emit a short telemetry event when pin is toggled. also need a cheap endpoint to resolve major-only to the current canonical minor for compare operations. sam: about compare table — proposal: inline compare (row expansion) vs modal compare. inline is faster but can be noisy at high density. recommend modal for >3 models. maria: in tests, people used modal for deep dives and inline for quick checks. default to inline but show "Open in modal" when you select >2 rows. olivia: decision check: adopt condensed metrics strip, hover/tap expand, add lock-mode for version pin with 3 resolution options, keyboard + screenreader labels, inline compare default but modal overflow. agree? anya: yes, i'll make a design PR with updated figma + copy. pinging @design-bot for preview link. design-bot: Preview published: https://figma.redwood.dev/file/metrics-strip-v2 — deploy preview in staging at /catalog?preview=metrics-strip (expires in 48h) sam: i'll spike front-end prototype tomorrow and post initial perf numbers. maria: i'll schedule quick follow-up guerilla test Wed morning. want to validate the major-only mental model. olivia: thanks team — small checklist: contrast pass, aria labels, undo toast copy, telemetry events, backend resolver for major pins. i'll mark this thread as accepted after PR. anya: ✅ will update by EOD and link PR here.
